Built on Code OSS: What That Means for You

Kiro looks familiar for a reason.
Kiro is built on Code OSS — the open-source core of VS Code.
Your settings, themes, and Open VSX extensions carry over.
You're not learning a brand new editor, just a smarter one.

Episode 4 of theAIgurukul's free Kiro series, a daily short on AWS's agentic IDE. Subscribe for the next one.
